transcript.content: Hello. Welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two years and four months, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy mood.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or feeling 'on top of the world' with very little need for sleep?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods of feeling unusually energetic or hyperactive; I've mostly just felt very depressed and low.
During these past two years and four months, have you ever had a period of two months or longer where you felt completely back to your normal self?
No, I don't think so. I can't recall any period over these past two years where I felt completely back to my normal self for that long. It feels like this low mood has just been constant.
Along with this constant low mood, have you struggled with things like low energy, changes in your sleep or appetite, or feelings of hopelessness?

Yes, my appetite has dropped significantly, and I have absolutely no energy or motivation to do anything. I constantly feel empty and hopeless, though I haven't really noticed any specific issues with my sleep.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in almost all activities that you used to enjoy?
Yes, absolutely. I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to love doing. I just don't feel any pleasure or happiness from them anymore.
Have you also been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt, or have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?

I don't really struggle with feelings of worthlessness or guilt, but I have been having very frequent thoughts of death and wanting to die. Often, I just wish I wouldn't wake up in the morning, and I sometimes get sudden, scary impulses like wanting to jump from high places.
To help me rule out other causes, do you have any medical conditions, like thyroid issues, or have you been using any substances or medications recently?
No, I don't have any medical conditions like thyroid problems that I know of. I am also not currently taking any medications or using any substances.
During this long period of depression, have you ever heard voices or seen things that others couldn't, or had any strong beliefs or fears that other people found unusual or unrealistic?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I have never heard voices or seen things that aren't there, and I don't hold any unusual beliefs or fears.
